qt: to the Commission Chris MacManus (The Left) Subject:

Is the Commission aware of any court case that has ever tested whether direct funding from the EU budget for the EU’s Defence Technological and Industrial Base, i.e. defence industry, is compatible with, or contravenes, Article 41(2) of the Treaty on European Union, which prohibits EU budget expenditure on operations that have military or defence implications?
at: (English version) to the Commission Chris MacManus (The Left) (9 January 2024) Subject: EU budget Is the Commission aware of any court case that has ever tested whether direct funding from the EU budget for the EU’s Defence Technological and Industrial Base, i.e. defence industry, is compatible with, or contravenes, Article 41(2) of the Treaty on European Union, which prohibits EU budget expenditure on operations that have military or defence implications? (4 April 2024) In compliance with Article 41(2) of the Treaty on European Union (TEU) (1), the EU budget is not funding expenditure arising from operations having military or defence implications under the Common Foreign and Security Policy. The EU budget is providing support for the EU’s Defence Technological and Industrial Base (in particular under Article 173 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union) by incentivising the supply-side, e.g. Research and Development, upgrades of production facilities, etc. and the demand-side, e.g. procurement cooperation between Member States. However, any expenditure for operations having military or defence implications is out of scope of these industry support programmes. Any such expenditure would, if necessary, have to be funded in accordance with Article 41(2) TEU through ‘off-budget’ instruments such as the European Peace Facility (2). In the absence of the EU budget funding expenditure arising from operations having military or defence implications, the Commission is accordingly not aware of any cases challenging EU funding for the EU’s Defence Technological and Industrial Base in relation to Article 41(2) TEU.
